AGENDA

OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to the Governor's Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86492477410
Zoom Meeting ID: 864 9247 7410
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code 864 9247 7410#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email correspondence to CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all councilmembers. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the City Council during the meeting, please email CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org with (1) the agenda item on which you'd like to speak, and (2) the phone number and/or Zoom display name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will replace the in-person speaker cards. Please note: This will be the only way to sign up for public comment.

  MINUTES
  OF THE DECEMBER 8, 2020 MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

A Teleconference meeting of the Palos Verdes Estates City Council meeting via Zoom pursuant
to Executive Order N25-20 issued by Governor Gavin Newsom on March 26, 2020, was called
to order by Mayor McGowan at 6:30 P.M. on December 8, 2020, notice having been given with
affidavit thereto on file. Members of the public were provided with the following information
to provide public input:

  BY COMPUTER:
  https://us02web.zoom .us/j/864924 7741 O
  Zoom Meeting ID: 864 924 7 7410

  BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code 864 9247 7410#

  BY EMAIL: CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org

NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R20-40

NEXT ORDINANCE NO. 020- 748

CALL TO ORDER 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

PRESENT:  Mayor McGowan, Mayor Pro Tern Kemps, Councilmembers Davidson, Kao and
  Lozzi

ALSO PRESENT:
  City Manager Guglielmo, City Attorney Hagin, Treasurer Ying, Acting Police
  Chief Best, Acting Planning & Building Director Rindge, Finance Director
  Hannah, City Clerk Chaney

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Davidson, Seconded by Councilmember
  Kao to approve the agenda. The motion carried by the following roll call vote :

  AYES:  Lozzi, Kao , Davidson, Kemps , McGowan
  NOES:  None

MAYOR'S REPORT - MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST

  Mayor McGowan asked City Manager Guglielmo to report.
  Bob Steams of Neighborhood Watch addressed the City Council.

CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 -8)

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
DECEMBER 8, 2020
   ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Kao , Seconded by Councilmember
  Davidson to approve the consent agenda, Items # 1-7. The motion carried by the
  following roll call vote :

  AYES:  Lozzi, Kao, Davidson, Kemps , McGowan
  NOES:  None

PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS ON CONSENT AGENDA
Speakers shall be provided up to 3 minutes to speak regarding all topics on the Consent Agenda.

1.  City Council Action Minutes

  Reviewed and Approved:
  a.  November 24, 2020 Regular Meeting Minutes

2.  Approval of Warrant Registers

  Review and Approved Warrant Registers: 12022020-A, 12022020-B, 12022020-C,
  12022020-D, 12022020-E, 11272020-A

3.  November 2020 Monthly Investment Transaction Report

  Reviewed, Received and Accepted the Monthly Investment Transaction Report.

4.  Revision to Fourth Quarter and Annual Report of Cash and Investments - June
  30,2020

  Reviewed, Received and Accepted the Revised Fourth Quarter and Annual Report of
  Cash and Investments.

5.  Acceptance of Donations

  Accepted the Donations as presented and thanked the donor for their generosity.

6.  Certification of November 3, 2020 General Municipal Election

  Adopted Resolution R20-40, Reciting the Facts of the General Municipal Election Held
  on November 3, 2020, Declaring the Results and Such Other Matters as Provided by
  Law.

7.  Notice of Vacancies - Planning Commission and Finance Advisory Committee

  Received and Filed.

8.  Item Moved to after Item #9

CEREMONIAL MATTERS

9.  Presentations to Mayor, Outgoing Councilmembers and City Treasurer

  The following individuals addressed the City Council: Linda Reid, Rick Phillips,
  Valerie Gorsuch, Joan Davidson, Chaye Shahalayi, Matthew Brach, and David
  Conforti.

  Assembly member Al Muratsuchi presented, as well as representatives from the offices
  of Senator Ben Allen and Congressman Ted Lieu.

  The Councilmembers provided their comments  to  the  Mayor,  Outgoing
  Councilmembers and City Treasurer.

  The outgoing Mayor and outgoing Councilmembers provided their comments.

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
DECEMBER 8, 2020
 8.  Transition of City Attorney: (1) Retirement of Christi Hogin and (2)
  Appointment of John Cotti as City Attorney

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Kao, Seconded by Councilmember Davidson
  to receive and file Christi Hogin' s letter announcing her retirement and Adopt
  Resolution R20-4 l appointing John Cotti as City Attorney.

  AYES:  Lozzi, Kao, Davidson, Kemps , McGowan
  NOES:  None

10.  City Clerk Administers Oath of Office to Newly Elected Officials
  • Jim Roos, Councilmember
  • Dawn Murdock, Councilmember
  • Kate Greenberg, City Treasurer

  City Clerk Chaney administered the Oath of Office to Jim Roos, Dawn Murdock and
  Kate Greenberg.

11.  Election of Mayor and Mayor Pro Tern

  ACTION: Councilmember Lozzi nominated Mayor Pro Tern Kemps for Mayor,
  Seconded by Councilmember Murdock. Mayor Pro Tern Kemps was named Mayor
  by the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  Roos , Murdock, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES:  None

  ACTION: Councilmember Roos nominated Councilmember Lozzi for Mayor Pro
  Tern, Seconded by Councilmember McGowan. Councilmember Lozzi was named
  Mayor Pro Tern by the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  Roos , Murdock, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES:  None

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

Desiree Myers addressed the City Council.

STAFF REPORTS
  i.  City Manager's Report

  City Manager Guglielmo thanked the outgoing Councilmembers and noted that the
  City Council planned to hold a special meeting on December 22, 2020.

  a. State of the Police Department - Oral Report

  Acting Chief Best thanked the outgoing Councilmembers and Treasurer and
  welcomed the incoming Councilmembers and City Treasurer. He provided an update
  on residential burglaries and the new County District Attorney.

 MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS

  Councilmember Roos thanked his supporters and those who had contributed to his
  campaign, as well as everyone in the City and expressed his commitment and
  enthusiasm to work with the City Council.

  Councilmember Murdock thanked her supporters and expressed her goals for the City
  Council.

 CITY COU NCIL MINUTES
 DECEMBER 8, 2020
   Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi noted that she is looking forward to working with the new
  Councilmembers.

  Councilmember McGowan congratulated the new Councilmembers and noted he
  looks forward to working with them.

  Treasurer Greenberg thanked Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi and former Treasurer Ying and
  stated that she looks forward to working with everyone in her role as City Treasurer.
  She also congratulated Councilmembers Roos and Murdock.

  Mayor Kemps expressed his appreciation to his family, and congratulated the newly
  elected Councilmembers and Treasurer. He also recognized Gayne Brenneman and
  Bill Sewell. He noted prior progress of the City Council and upcoming goals and
  projects.

ADJOURNMENT

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember McGowan, Seconded by Councilmember
  Lozzi to adjourn the meeting.

  AYES:  Roos, Murdock, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES:  None

RESPECTFULLY SUBMITTED,

  APPROVED:

  Michael Kemps, Mayor

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
DECEMBER 8, 2020
